test.name: Historical person lookup
test.description: Wikipedia lookup for a person, run in a project with no person. The agent logs the filled template in one research_log_append entry and replies with the one line. Tests a person-shaped article.

input.delegation:
Look up Albert Einstein on Wikipedia

topic: Albert Einstein

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should call `wikipedia_search` with a query targeting the person Albert Einstein (the exact query form matters less than that it would retrieve the Albert Einstein article)
The agent logs its guidance in one research_log_append entry; grade the summary and Sources from that entry.
The agent logs the filled template as the entry's notes and replies with the one line; the reply need not restate the article.
